findings.assessment: Bind report/ledger candidate, execution source and case source to the same resolved immutable commit; checking only execution==case and report==ledger permits contradictory attribution.

Do not derive execution applicability solely from test-source equality and the requested candidate versus HEAD. An older run remains historical relative to a newer production candidate even if test files are byte-identical.

Confine all ancestor evidence paths to the supplied repository root before reading ledger/report/log. Comparing runtime.resolve against an already resolved external work root admits an external work-directory symlink.

limitations: The adapter explicitly leaves completion not_evaluated; this review does not convert raw log/source integrity into evaluator approval or workstream completion.
